name: ki-manager
description: Knowledge Item (KI) management MCP server for AI-assisted development. Keeps your codebase self-documenting for AI agents.

workspace.description: Absolute path to the project workspace root (optional — auto-detected from IDE context)

tools.name: ki_instructions
tools.description: Return a bundled workflow instruction document (overview, knowledge-items, create-adr, expand-knowledge, sync-knowledge, scaffold-knowledge).

tools.name: ki_init_project
tools.description: Initialize a new ki-manager project: creates .ki-base/ structure with config, AGENTS.md, DIR_INDEX.md and a starter _OVERVIEW.ki.md.

project_path.description: Absolute path to the project root

language.description: Primary language: python, typescript, etc. (default: python)

venv_python.description: Explicit path to venv python.exe (auto-detected if omitted)

tools.name: ki_migrate_project
tools.description: Migrate a legacy .know/ project to the modern .ki-base/ architecture.

tools.name: ki_register_project
tools.description: Register an existing project (with .ki-base/ki_config.json) in the global registry.

tools.name: ki_list_projects
tools.description: List all projects registered in the global KI registry.

tools.name: ki_status
tools.description: Check which project is active for the current workspace.

path.description: Path to check (defaults to workspace root)

tools.name: ki_prune_registry
tools.description: Remove projects from the registry whose directories no longer exist.

tools.name: audit_coverage
tools.description: Analyze how well the knowledge base covers the actual codebase. Reports blind spots, critical gaps, complexity warnings, and low-density KIs.

tools.name: generate_dir_index
tools.description: Generate or update .ki-base/DIR_INDEX.md with the project directory structure.

tools.name: analyze_dependencies
tools.description: Analyze Python/TS imports to update the 'Related KIs' section in a specific KI file.

only_changed.description: Only process KIs for changed files

tools.name: analyze_all_dependencies
tools.description: Analyze all KI files and update their 'Related KIs' sections based on code imports.

tools.name: find_unmapped_files
tools.description: Find source files not covered by any KI.

tools.name: analyze_module
tools.description: Analyze directory stats with knowledge context: file count, KI coverage, etc.

tools.name: ki_scaffold
tools.description: Generate scaffold KI stub files for all uncovered modules in one pass. Extracts class/function names via regex (Python, TypeScript, JS, Go). Marks generated KIs with <!-- scaffold: true --> for subsequent AI enrichment.

modules.description: Comma-separated module paths or labels to scaffold (default: all uncovered)

dry_run.description: Show what would be created without writing files (default: false)

force.description: Overwrite existing KI files that have the scaffold marker (default: false)

tools.name: ki_scaffold_status
tools.description: Print a concise status table of all scaffold KIs: pending (<!-- scaffold: true -->) vs enriched (<!-- scaffold: enriched -->).

tools.name: ki_finalize_scaffolds
tools.description: Finalize all enriched scaffold KI files: removes <!-- scaffold: enriched --> markers and updates doc_config.json summaries from Overview text. Run after all stubs are enriched.

dry_run.description: Show what would change without writing files (default: false)

tools.name: update_last_verified
tools.description: Update the last_verified date in all KI files to today.

tools.name: read_know_file
tools.description: Read a Knowledge Item (KI) file inside the .ki-base/ directory.

tools.name: write_know_file
tools.description: Create or overwrite a file inside .ki-base/ (scripts and executables are protected).

tools.name: edit_know_file
tools.description: Edit a file inside .ki-base/ by replacing a specific text fragment.

tools.name: make_know_dir
tools.description: Create a new subdirectory inside .ki-base/.

tools.name: git_checkpoint
tools.description: Stage and commit all .ki-base/ changes to git.

tools.name: git_restore
tools.description: Restore a file inside .ki-base/ from a git revision.

tools.name: git_diff_secured
tools.description: Get git diff for project files (sandboxed to project directory).

tools.name: save_state
tools.description: Capture and save file hash state to doc_state.json.

tools.name: restore_mapping
tools.description: Restore doc_config.json from existing KI files.
